title: Practice 6: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том ___ (таскать — to drag, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) Мэри за волосы.
exercises.why: **таскает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of таскать: many-directions verb (one direction: тащить).

exercises.q: Том только учится ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general; impf., inf.).
exercises.why: **ползать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).
exercises.prompt: Tom is just learning to crawl.

exercises.q: Он ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) на четвереньках.
exercises.why: **ползал** — past tense (masculine) of ползать: many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).

exercises.q: Они ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) на четвереньках.
exercises.why: **ползали** — past tense (plural) of ползать: many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).
exercises.prompt: They were walking on all fours.

exercises.q: Кот ___ (лазить — to climb, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) по всей Светлане.
exercises.why: **лазил** — past tense (masculine) of лазить: many-directions verb (one direction: лезть).
exercises.prompt: The cat was climbing all over Svetlana.

exercises.q: Он ___ (бродить — to wander, plod, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) туда и сюда.
exercises.why: **бродил** — past tense (masculine) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).

exercises.q: Лосось ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) вверх по течению на нерест.
exercises.why: **плывёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).

exercises.q: Толпа детишек ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) за кроликом.
exercises.why: **бегала** — past tense (feminine) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: A bunch of children ran after the rabbit.

exercises.q: Он ___ (бродить — to wander, plod, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) вокруг озера.
exercises.why: **бродил** — past tense (masculine) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).

exercises.q: Дети ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) взад-вперёд по парку.
exercises.why: **бегали** — past tense (plural) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: Children were running to and fro in the park.

exercises.q: Целый день по шоссе непрерывным потоком ___ (катить — to roll, one way; impf., past pl.) машины.
exercises.why: **катили** — past tense (plural) of катить: one-direction verb (many directions: катать).
exercises.prompt: There's been a steady stream of cars on the highway all day.

exercises.q: Мичу увидел: обвивая дуб, наверх ___ (ползти — to crawl, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) большая змея.
exercises.why: **ползёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ползти: one-direction verb (many directions: ползать).
exercises.prompt: Michu saw a large snake crawling upward, twisting around an oak tree.

exercises.q: Медведи могут ___ (лазать — to climb, there and back or in general; impf., inf.) по деревьям.
exercises.why: **лазать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: лезть).

exercises.q: От мысли о сахарной пудре у меня по коже ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) мурашки.
exercises.why: **бегут** — future tense (3rd person plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: The thought of powdered sugar makes my skin crawl.

exercises.q: В Далласе холоднее, чем здесь! Куда ___ (катиться — to roll (oneself; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)) этот мир?
exercises.why: **катится** — present tense (3rd person singular) of катиться: one-direction verb (many directions: кататься).
exercises.prompt: It's colder in Dallas than it is here! What is this world coming to?

exercises.q: Kashtanka ran back and forth but couldn't find her master. Meanwhile, it was getting dark.
exercises.why: **бегала** — past tense (feminine) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.ru: Каштанка ___ взад и вперёд и не находила хозяина, а между тем становилось темно.

exercises.q: Антилопы чрезвычайно быстро ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **бегают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).

exercises.q: Том ___ (гонять — to drive, chase, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) еду по тарелке.
exercises.why: **гонял** — past tense (masculine) of гонять: many-directions verb (one direction: гнать).
exercises.prompt: Tom pushed the food around his plate.

exercises.q: Я в кармане ___ (таскать — to drag, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.) связку ключей.
exercises.why: **таскаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of таскать: many-directions verb (one direction: тащить).
exercises.prompt: I carry my set of keys in my pocket.

exercises.q: Он ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) в бассейне.
exercises.why: **плавает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: He is swimming in the pool.
